scope: First three retained MATH questions, inspected during preparation; not a statistical audit of all training examples.
completion_limit_observation: Several accepted outputs contain an explicit correct boxed answer in the reasoning segment, then hit the1024-token limit during the repeated visible explanation. The existing declared verifier searches explicit answer tags/boxes over the full generated text and therefore accepts these outputs. This is not an arbitrary last-number fallback, but success does not guarantee a completed visible final response. Preserve this policy across conditions; report capping and distinguish it from complete-response quality.
